q-225055.name: Question 3
q-225055.worked_solution:
The cumulative distribution function of a discrete random variable $X$ is a function $F(x)$ such that

$$
F(x)=P(X\le x).
$$

So, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}F(4) & =P(X\le 4) \\  & =P(X\in \{0,1,2,3,4\}) \\  & =P(X\in \{0,1\})+P(X\in \{2,3,4\}) \\  & =P(X\le 1)+P(2\le X\le 4) \\  & =F(1)+P(2\le X\le 4).\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}P(2\le X\le 4) & =F(4)-F(1) \\  & =0.4405-0.0404 \\  & =0.4001.\end{aligned}
$$

x 0 1 2 3 4 5 6
P(X≤x) 0.0067 0.0404 0.1247 0.2650 0.4405 0.6160 0.7622
P(2≤X≤4)=
0.4001
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

The cumulative distribution function of a discrete random variable X is a function F(x) such that

F(x)=P(X≤x).

So, we have

F(4)=P(X≤4)=P(X∈{0,1,2,3,4})=P(X∈{0,1})+P(X∈{2,3,4})=P(X≤1)+P(2≤X≤4)=F(1)+P(2≤X≤4).

Therefore,

P(2≤X≤4)=F(4)−F(1)=0.4405−0.0404=0.4001.

q-225067.name: Question 4
q-225067.worked_solution:
The cumulative distribution function of a discrete random variable $X$ is a function $F(x)$ such that

$$
F(x)=P(X\le x).
$$

So, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}F(5) & =P(X<6) \\  & =P(X\in \{0,1,2,3,4,5\}) \\  & =P(X\in \{0,1,2\})+P(X\in \{3,4,5\}) \\  & =P(X\le 2)+P(3\le X<6) \\  & =F(2)+P(3\le X<6).\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore,

$$
\begin{aligned}P(3\le X<6) & =F(5)-F(2) \\  & =0.7851-0.2381 \\  & =0.5470.\end{aligned}
$$

q-225087.name: Question 5
q-225087.worked_solution:
The cumulative distribution function of a discrete random variable $X$ is a function $F(x)$ such that

$$
F(x)=P(X\le x).
$$

To solve the given problem, we can use the rule

$$
P(X>a)=1-P(X\le a)=1-F(a).
$$

Now, note that 

$$
P(X\ge 5)=P(X>4).
$$

 

Therefore, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}P(X\ge 5) & =P(X>4) \\  & =1-P(X\le 4) \\  & =1-F(4) \\  & =1-0.7064 \\  & =0.2936.\end{aligned}
$$

EXPLANATION

The cumulative distribution function of a discrete random variable X is a function F(x) such that

F(x)=P(X≤x).

To solve the given problem, we can use the rule

P(X>a)=1−P(X≤a)=1−F(a).

Now, note that

P(X≥5)=P(X>4).

Therefore, we have

P(X≥5)=P(X>4)=1−P(X≤4)=1−F(4)=1−0.7064=0.2936.
